Ira Gitler is one of America’s most respected jazz historians and writers. As a native of New York City, he grew up surrounded by jazz and the influential musicians who created it. After completing his education at the University of Mississippi and Columbia University, he worked for Prestige Records and helped this label become an important home for jazz during the fifties. His work with Leonard Feather on the Encyclopedia of Jazz was followed by writing assignments for Down Beat and Metronome. Ira has written scripts for documentaries on Lionel Hampton and Louis Armstrong. Currently Ira holds the position of Jazz Historian at the Manhattan School of Music.

We are here in New York City and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. We have with us today one of our country’s finest jazz historians, Ira Gitler. Pleased to have you.
